---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for aml-filter
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What problem does this solve?**
The use case or pain point, not just the proposed solution.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see — a new watchlist source adapter, a scoring signal, a review-board
capability, a Settings knob, etc.

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches you weighed and why this one is better.

**Scope / fit**
How does this fit aml-filter's role as a **zero-server, in-browser** screening + local-first
KYC demo (everything runs client-side; the lists are signed static files)? Does it belong in
the publisher (`@amlfilter/publisher`), the in-tab engine (`@amlfilter/browser`), the
workstation tier (`@amlfilter/workstation`), or the React SPA?

**Additional context**
Links, prior art, or sketches.
